guard: the auth-owned sealed records scanner exposes one closed manager-scoped native-binding query, keeps released-unproven rows, proves known-empty distinctly, rejects malformed state, and never hands a records credential, filter, connection, or consumer to runtime callers
why: The suite reaches the real sealed scanner over an isolated broker with no injected reader at the consuming operation.
The exact scanner grant census permits only oblig.> and sessionbinding.* enumeration on the one literal pull consumer, with no records writes or other records families.
Known-empty, another manager's binding, released-unproven, malformed principal, malformed row, and post-construction method swap are separate named cells.

mutations.name: native query silently widens to the records root
mutations.expectRed: real sealed native-binding query proves a legacy-empty inventory
mutations.cell: real sealed native-binding query proves a legacy-empty inventory

mutations.name: native query returns another manager's binding
mutations.expectRed: closed query returns only THIS manager principal's live binding
mutations.cell: closed query returns only THIS manager principal's live binding

mutations.name: released-labelled unproven binding is dropped as not live
mutations.expectRed: released-labelled binding with no receipt still reaches the shutdown lookup
mutations.cell: released-labelled binding with no receipt still reaches the shutdown lookup

mutations.name: malformed binding row is skipped as empty
mutations.replace: let binding; try { binding = parseBinding(row.data, row.key); } catch { continue; }
mutations.expectRed: malformed binding row is explicit unknown, not empty
mutations.cell: malformed binding row is explicit unknown, not empty

mutations.name: scanner handle is not frozen
mutations.expectRed: sealed scanner handle is frozen against a silent-empty method swap
mutations.cell: sealed scanner handle is frozen against a silent-empty method swap

mutations.name: permission failure is collapsed into known-empty
mutations.find: return { status: "unknown", bindings: [] as const, reason: (e as Error).message };
mutations.expectRed: real broker permission failure is explicit unknown and distinct from known-empty
mutations.cell: real broker permission failure is explicit unknown and distinct from known-empty
